permissions.screenRecordingNeeded: Recordly нужно разрешение на запись экрана. Мы открыли настройки – включите доступ и перезапустите приложение.
permissions.screenRecordingMissing: Доступа к записи экрана всё ещё нет. Мы снова открыли настройки. Разрешите доступ и перезапустите Recordly.
permissions.accessibilityNeeded: Разрешите Recordly использовать универсальный доступ, чтобы отслеживать курсор. Мы открыли настройки – включите его и перезапустите приложение.
permissions.accessibilityMissing: Разрешения для универсального доступа всё ещё нет. Включите его в настройках и перезапустите Recordly.
permissions.systemAudioUnavailable: Системные звуки недоступны для этого источника. Запись продолжится без их захвата.
permissions.microphoneDenied: Нет доступа к микрофону. Запись продолжится без вашего голоса.

updateToast.experimentalDescription: Вы включили экспериментальные обновления, поэтому можете протестировать последнее обновление Recordly до его широкого выпуска.

ios.empty: Connect your iPhone or iPad with a USB cable. Unlock it and tap Trust if asked.
ios.help: Use a cable that supports data. Close QuickTime or other apps using the device.
ios.previewQuality: Preview quality only — recording uses the device stream.
ios.orientation: Keep one orientation during a take. Recordly does not lock your device orientation.
ios.unsupportedControls: Pause and webcam are unavailable for device recording.
ios.actionFailed: The device action could not be completed. Check the capture status and try again.

status.interrupted: Recording interrupted. Check recovery for saved media.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Device capture is unavailable on this platform.
errors.HELPER_UNAVAILABLE: Device capture helper is missing. Reinstall or update Recordly.
errors.PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: Device capture helper is incompatible. Reinstall or update Recordly.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Camera or microphone permission was denied. Enable the required permission for Recordly in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then retry.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: The selected device is no longer available. Reconnect it and refresh.
errors.DEVICE_BUSY: Another application may be using this device. Close it and retry.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This device video format is not supported.
errors.NO_VIDEO_SAMPLES: No valid video samples arrived. Check the device connection and retry.
errors.CLOCK_MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE: The device media clock could not be mapped safely.
errors.RECORDING_BUSY: Another recording is using capture. Finish it before starting again.
errors.FORMAT_CHANGED: The device video format changed. Capture stopped to preserve the preceding take. Keep one orientation and check the saved recording or recovery.
errors.DEVICE_DISCONNECTED: The device disconnected. Check the saved recording or recovery.
errors.AUDIO_INTERRUPTED: An audio source was interrupted. Check the saved recording or recovery.
errors.DISK_SPACE_LOW: Available recording storage is low. Capture stopped to preserve media.
errors.WRITER_FAILED: The recording writer failed. Check recovery for preserved media.
errors.FINALIZATION_FAILED: The recording could not be saved. Check recovery for preserved media.
errors.HELPER_EXITED: Device capture stopped unexpectedly. Check recovery for preserved media.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The selected capture session changed. Select the device again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION: This action is unavailable for device recording.

recovery.failed: Recovery could not be completed. Your source files have been kept.
